title: feat(2d)!: retire Adaptive strategy from 2D Pocket
body:
Process change: yes

## What changed
- Remove `"Adaptive"` from 2D Pocket's `strategy_names()` UI list and update `mill2d_page` combo indices.
- Keep `"Adaptive"` in `strategy3d_names()` for 3D Pocket, Multi-axis Rough, and Rotary Offset until #1591.
- Refuse `OpParams::Pocket { strategy: PocketStrategy::Adaptive, .. }` with `POCKET_ADAPTIVE_RETIRED` in `OpParams::named_refusal`, `OpParams::is_sane`, commands, MCP tools, scripting, and `operation::generate`.
- Bump `PROJECT_VERSION` from 64 to 65.
- Add `pocket_adaptive_migrate::settle` to migrate version `< 65` `Pocket + Adaptive` operations to `Adaptive2D (Spiral)` on load and clear their stale generation stamp.
- Refuse version `>= 65` project files carrying `Pocket` with `strategy: "adaptive"` as corrupt.
- Turn off un-carriable `rest` and `links.approach.predrilled` fields on migration, drop stale caches, and emit load notes (`open_project` and `cam.load` JSON).
- Persist dropped reasons in `OperationMeta::needs_review` and block `posting::program_ops`, `verification_report_by`, and MCP `verify` or `post` while set.
- Show `"needs review"` plus `BadgeWarning` in `browser_tree` and a `"Mark reviewed"` banner in `op_page`.
- Add undoable `MarkOperationReviewed` and MCP `mark_operation_reviewed`, and update `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`.

## Cause
- Keeping Adaptive clearing in both `2D Pocket` and `2D Adaptive` confused users after #1509 added `Method` (`Spiral | Trochoidal`) on `2D Adaptive` alone.

## Tests

Review fixes on `eda3df83dfbda517ec7f4b96649acda68cd3c336`:

- `pasted_legacy_operation_requires_review_after_source_deletion`: empty pasted notes made the app pin RED. Restoring note propagation made it GREEN.
- `clipboard_keeps_review_notes_after_source_is_deleted`: empty clipboard notes made the UI pin RED. Restoring note propagation made it GREEN.
- `v63_pocket_adaptive_opens_as_adaptive2d_with_identical_toolpath`: halving the migrated feed made the independent legacy CL comparison RED. Restoring the feed made it GREEN.
- `a_face_with_an_island_and_its_rim_loop_cut_the_same_bytes_around_the_boss_full`: replacing Adaptive2D with OffsetRings made the pin RED. Restoring Adaptive2D made the release heavy test GREEN.
- App clippy passed with `-D warnings` for the library, binaries, and `copy_review`, `pocket_no_adaptive`, `pick_agnostic`, and `sinker_side` targets.
- UI all-target clippy passed with `-D warnings`.
- Combined app/UI all-target clippy failed on unchanged upstream `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106-107`. The errors expect `Option<WorkMaterial>` and report missing `stepdown` and `stepover` fields.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: RED. The app no-run build fails on unchanged upstream `wire_tool.rs:106-107`. App `lib`, `accessory_collisions`, and `adaptive_pinch` passed. Remaining selected suites were stopped after the compile failure and quick-gate budget overrun. They are not reported as passed.

Historical validation on earlier heads follows:

- App pins (`crates/app/tests/pocket_no_adaptive.rs`; all 4 failed before fix, all 4 pass after fix): `pocket_adaptive_is_refused_at_every_door`, `v63_pocket_adaptive_opens_as_adaptive2d_with_identical_toolpath`, `v63_uncarriable_params_mark_needs_review_and_block_posting`, `current_version_file_with_pocket_adaptive_is_refused_as_corrupt`.
- UI pins (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pocket_no_adaptive.rs`; both failed before fix, both pass after fix): `pocket_strategy_list_drops_adaptive_while_3d_keeps_it`, `migrated_uncarriable_op_shows_needs_review_and_mark_reviewed_clears`.
- Mutation checks (each reverted -> failed, restored -> passed): `sane.rs` guard (`pocket_adaptive_is_refused_at_every_door`), `generate.rs` guard (`pocket_adaptive_is_refused_at_every_door`), `apply.rs` migration call (`v63_pocket_adaptive_opens_as_adaptive2d_with_identical_toolpath`), `posting.rs` review block (`v63_uncarriable_params_mark_needs_review_and_block_posting`), `ui/src/operations.rs` strategy list (`pocket_strategy_list_drops_adaptive_while_3d_keeps_it`).
- UI quick gate on `38f43073e`: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only ui` passed (16 steps, 0 failed), `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib pocket_no_adaptive` passed (2/2), and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- App unit tests on `38f43073e`: `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` passed (353 passed, 0 failed, 1 heavy-lane ignored).
- App integration tests on `38f43073e`: `pocket_no_adaptive` (4/4), `project_roundtrip` (73/73), `rest_pocket` (6/6), `pick_agnostic` (5 passed, 2 ignored), `climb_direction` (2/2), `docs_troubleshooting` (1/1), `operation_metadata` (5/5), `pocket_overhead` (2/2), `predrilled_entry` (8/8), `roughing2d` (7/7), `scripting` (19/19), `units_in_refusals` (5/5), `first_router_part` (4/4), `mcp` (22/22), `mcp_order` (3/3), `mcp_verify` (3/3), `mcp_pockets` (3/3), `operations` (120 passed, 6 ignored), `posting` (17/17), and `program_entry` (9/9) all passed.
- App clippy on `38f43073e`: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib --bins` plus all 20 tested `-p camcraft-app` integration targets `-- -D warnings` passed.

## Goldens moved
- No existing CL, G-code, or snapshot lines moved.
- Added `crates/app/tests/golden/pocket_adaptive_v63.cl`. It records output from the unchanged old Pocket Adaptive generator at `a529c455352d8c2d228e3dd83d0e5d42a91ea9b0`.

## Not exercised
- Full `cargo xtask gate quick` and `--all-targets` clippy on `camcraft-app` after merging `upstream/main` (`e3f7d122b`): upstream `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs` fails to compile (#2244). Pre-update `cargo xtask gate quick` passed (`wall 45.2 min, 2 step(s), 0 failed`) before that merge.
- Unrelated `camcraft-app` integration binaries not in the 20 suites above were not re-run after merging `e3f7d122b`.

## UI before and after

These captures render the real shell with the headless UI harness. The Browser and Properties panes are widened for readability.
Before uses `a529c4553`, before this feature. After uses the reviewed head `38f43073e`.
Both runs open the same legacy project with pre-drilled Adaptive entry. The strategy captures show the same new Pocket operation.

| State | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Migration review banner, Mark reviewed button, and browser warning | ![Before migration review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/abc9b5c40dfb27a560362a2b97aecb7908f7acc1/2253/before-review-warning.png) | ![After migration review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/abc9b5c40dfb27a560362a2b97aecb7908f7acc1/2253/after-review-warning.png) |
| Expanded Pocket strategy list | ![Before Pocket strategies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/abc9b5c40dfb27a560362a2b97aecb7908f7acc1/2253/before-pocket-strategy.png) | ![After Pocket strategies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/abc9b5c40dfb27a560362a2b97aecb7908f7acc1/2253/after-pocket-strategy.png) |

The four PNG files are stored only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, at `abc9b5c40dfb27a560362a2b97aecb7908f7acc1`.
No capture harness, screenshot, or review log is added to the PR branch.

## Overlaps
- Touches the same files in different functions as open PRs #2245, #2236, #2229, #2197, #2187, #2185, #2162, #2157, #2150, #2149, #2146, #2136, #2134, #2096, #2092, #2090, #2089, #2078, #2077, #2068, #2048, #2037, #2035, #2024, #2013, #1996, #1931, #1821, #1798, #1738, #1713, #1681, #1330, and #1209. Whichever merges second refreshes.

BREAKING CHANGE: project files are written as version 65; older builds refuse them.
Changelog: Retire Adaptive strategy from 2D Pocket, migrate pre-v65 projects to 2D Adaptive (Spiral) with a needs-review posting block for dropped settings, and bump PROJECT_VERSION to 65.
Fixes #1517
